text:
Sana Iqbal: Marketplace intake flagged our joint listing with EdgeOps: they want a pen-test attestation plus an artifacts manifest. They called out need for a remediations timeline. cc @Ethan Ross @Marta Silva
Ethan Ross: Do they want full pen report or just an attestation + executive summary?
Marta Silva: Likely exec summary + remediation tracker. We should avoid sending PoC attachments.
evidence-bot: Draft manifest created: pen-exec-summary.pdf (14d), remediation-tracker.csv (30d), artifact-manifest.json (7d). Manifest ID: mf-edge-1850001111.
Sana Iqbal: Good. Also they asked for an attestation that our runtime on partner devices uses signed images. Can we provide a short signed statement from firmware team?
Ethan Ross: Yes — firmware team can provide a signed image policy statement and the current image signing cert fingerprint. I'll get that.
Marta Silva: Legal: do we need a notarized statement or is a signed attestation enough for this marketplace? @legal-sig
legal-sig: For this EU-adjacent catalog a signed attestation is sufficient. Notarization not required. We'll provide a short legal attestation page referencing the manifest.
Sana Iqbal: Action items: Ethan -> image signing cert fingerprint + signed policy (due 12h). Marta -> pen exec summary + remediation tracker (due EOD). legal-sig -> attestation blurb (due EOD). evidence-bot -> pre-create presign URLs when files are uploaded.
Ethan Ross: Uploaded firmware-cert.txt to internal bucket. Fingerprint: sha256: aa:bb:cc:... I will upload to manifest when Marta confirms readiness.
Marta Silva: Pen exec summary drafted. Removed PII and exploit details. Tracker csv includes vuln id, severity, status, owner, ETA.
legal-sig: Attestation drafted and attached: "Redwood Inference attests that runtime images are cryptographically signed; private keys are managed in HSM and not exportable."
evidence-bot: Uploaded files and generated presigned URLs. TTLs: 7-30 days per manifest. Manifest ready: mf-edge-1850001111.
EdgeOps: Thanks. We'll review and may request a short live call to verify image signing workflow.
Sana Iqbal: If they request live demo, schedule with infra-sre and firmware. For now, share manifest and README.
Marta Silva: README added with redaction notes and contact points.
Sana Iqbal: Great work. Closing this thread unless reviewer asks follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
